paper.title_en: The Fifth RIT Catalog of Binary Black Hole Simulations: Multiple-Resolution Studies of Eccentric Orbits
paper.abstract_en: This fifth release of the RIT public catalog of numerical relativity binary black hole waveforms http://ccrg.rit.edu/~RITCatalog introduces an additional 248 configurations, prioritizing 197 newly simulated eccentric orbits. This update brings the catalog to a total of 2129 cases. All waveforms are corrected for center-of-mass drift and extrapolated to future null infinity. To rigorously estimate waveform errors, we conduct multiple-resolution convergence studies on 10 eccentric simulations (up to 33 orbits to merger) using three global resolutions increasing by factors of 1.2, plus a comprehensive six-resolution study for a single 18-orbit configuration. We evaluate waveform accuracy by computing mismatches against theoretical infinite-resolution extrapolations. Additionally, we analyze the convergence properties of key physical observables: merger times, number of orbits, final masses, final spins, recoil velocities, and the peak amplitude, frequency, and luminosity of the gravitational radiation.

decision.reject_reason_zh: 该论文是数值相对论双黑洞波形的目录与收敛性研究，属于引力波源建模数据，而非所支持的三个引力理论主题（度规仿射引力、帕拉蒂尼引力、修改引力）；first_stage 仅以“null infinity”这一弱相关命中将其归入 general_relativity_foundations，但实际不涉及引力理论基础问题，因此不相关。
decision.title_zh: RIT 双黑洞模拟第五版目录：偏心轨道的多分辨率研究
decision.abstract_zh: 这是 RIT 数值相对论双黑洞波形公开目录（http://ccrg.rit.edu/~RITCatalog）的第五次发布，新增 248 个配置，其中优先包含 197 个新模拟的偏心轨道。此次更新使目录总数达到 2129 个案例。所有波形均已校正质心漂移，并外推到未来零无穷。为严格估计波形误差，我们对 10 个偏心模拟（最多至并合前 33 圈）开展了多分辨率收敛性研究，使用三个全局分辨率，每次提高 1.2 倍，并对单个 18 圈配置进行了全面的六分辨率研究。我们通过计算与理论无限分辨率外推结果的失配来评估波形精度。此外，我们分析了关键物理可观测量的收敛性质：并合时间、圈数、最终质量、最终自旋、反冲速度，以及引力辐射的峰值振幅、频率和光度。
